changes_from_v2_3: scope: every GPU job of M5. The author decided on 2026-11-05 that M5 runs experiments to understand the system and stays off main: no protocol v3, no confirmation set, no merge. Models, sampling, panels D48 and K128b, seeds, closed-loop rules, the verify schedule and the decision rules are v2.3's
lines: the 0.6B baseline's lines leave, this protocol does not run them; dflash_k7 comes back from v2.1; the round-robin arms join
invalid_if: preemption is the scheduler's count, not excess prefill tokens; a slow step is judged within its kind
open_loop, pilot, samehost, diagnosis, round_robin and long_context are new

gates: unchanged and not run here, except the G4's equivalence inside identity: a version whose tokens equal a gated version's needs no new gate; the tools' G1-wide and G2-real changes wait for a protocol that runs them

gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

main.rule: a clean clone of one commit from a git bundle of the local branch, which stays off the public repository; every line's --commit

diagnosis.rule: local as well; a patch that exists only to measure stays here

order: all lines of one (C, seed) run back to back in one job; the i-th seed (0-based) of a panel starts with the (i mod n)-th of that panel's n lines (dev.lines on D48, confirm.versions on K128b) and continues in listed order
kv_budget: C * ceil((max_prompt_len + max_tokens + 7) / 256) target blocks for every line; a block draft's cache mirrors the target's blocks

warmup.requests: first C of the panel, cycled

decision.a_beats_b: all paired gains same sign and abs(median) > 2*N_t
decision.report: median (min-max), two decimals; range only if max-min > 0.05. The README's headline, total table and figures are the exception: only the median of the 3 seeds, marked as such; the ranges go in RESULTS
decision.revised: 2026-11-02: the README rule of report decided by the author; the verdicts are unchanged

invalid_if: a step other than a prefill > 3 x the median of its kind
lines of one (C, seed) split across jobs: one job is one directory, protocol and panel, each line at the commit of its tree

verify_schedule.made_by: job A on a G4 runtime at 5bf4cbc: tools/profile_verify_cost.py, then tools/fit_confidence_sts.py; seed 17011's calibration run was invalid (a round 5.15 x its median). The first rerun ran on kernels compiled under TORCH_LOGS=recompiles, which changes the kernels and the outputs, so it is not job A's command and does not count; a clean rerun passed with byte-identical confidences; reviewed by the author before this protocol is frozen

cost_curve.round: one round's phase timings summed, propose through commit_copy, on CUDA events; every row verifies query_len positions through the variable-length path, the confidence copy included; fresh requests of context_len random tokens for every (batch, query_len)
cost_curve.revised: 2026-11-02 from v2.1's external.cost_curve, which timed the verify forward alone: the schedule weighs a whole round

calibration.record: every round, each row's 7 confidence logits and its accepted count; all 8 positions are verified, so 'the first i drafts all accepted' is observed for every i
calibration.method: STS: for i = 1..7 in turn, T_i on the grid minimizing the binary cross-entropy of the survival prod_{j<=i} sigmoid(z_j / T_j) against 'the first i drafts all accepted', T_1..T_{i-1} fixed
report_only: ECE over 10 equal-width bins, per position and pooled, raw and after STS
AUROC of the survival pooled over positions, raw and after STS

replay.rounds: the calibration runs' rounds of C rows
replay.rule: a row with n of its 7 drafts accepted accepts min(n, L - 1) when it verifies L positions; a round's time is the cost table's at its token count, the fixed-length round's at 8 per row
replay.source: 2 x N_t, N_t = 1.26% in the cluster's job 236550, kept until the G4's own is measured

confirm.runs_in: nowhere: M5 runs no confirmation set; the identity job only reads this concurrency

G2_multi.appendix_a: the early stop emits A within the bound of the target's 0.70; the global maximum's 0.85 lies outside it

equivalence.reference: repeat 1 of the cluster reproduction, job 236550

G1_wide.revised: 2026-10-23 after the first run: decode alone moves logits by up to 1.5 between B=1 and B=16 on these prompts, so the fixed bound 0.5 was below the reference path's own batch-size noise; the bound is now floor_multiple x the decode-only noise floor measured on the same prompts in the same job (the rule G1-aux had)

varlen.rule: one batch of the 8 prompts per rotation of the lengths, so each prompt verifies each length once, with the graph's empty row slots and padding tokens; each row's first L positions against the reference's first L decode steps, under the same bound and argmax rule

graph_eager_varlen.rule: the G1_wide varlen batches through the verification graph and eagerly: bit-identical logits

G2_real.revised: 2026-10-23 after the first run: both lines picked the same position, where the target split 0.5/0.5 over two tokens and the draft put all its mass on one; a one-hot q tests only the trivial residual, so q must now be positive on at least min_draft_support tokens
G2_real.revised_again: 2026-10-23 after the second run: both picked positions had a one-hot target p, so every rejection emits the one target token and the output-distribution check passes trivially (gap 0); p must now be positive on at least min_target_support tokens (decision D3)

identity.rule: the tree at the job's commit against the reference's tokens, request by request, and the environment against job C's manifest: outputs/colab/m4-preflight.sh, m4-preflight-check.py. dev.lines on D48 at confirm.concurrency, seed 17011, against job C's repeat 1; gates.equivalence's dspark_k7 on K128b under protocol v2.1, against the cluster reproduction's repeat 1
identity.why: the fields of T1, the admission cap of T2 and the eager fallback of T5 must not change a token: the cap is redundant with at most C in flight

pilot.report: never: pilots only size what follows, and run under this protocol so no GPU job runs before a freeze

max_model_len.compare: the identity job's runs at 4096, same VM

long_context.rule: length is the final Qwen-formatted token count; the panels are reported on only, since length and content change together

open_loop.order: for each rate in order, the lines in listed order, back to back in one job
open_loop.arrivals: Poisson, generated before the run from --seed by a generator of its own; every line of a (rate, seed) gets the same plan; the panel cycles in order
open_loop.warmup: the closed-loop warm-up runs first, then the plan starts. The first warmup_fraction of the planned requests run and are not counted, whatever the line; every later one counts
open_loop.drain: no request is added after the plan's last; a request unfinished drain_seconds after the last arrival counts as an infinite latency
open_loop.clock: latencies run on the host's clock from the planned arrival to the return of the step that delivered; round durations stay on CUDA events; the two never enter one number
open_loop.gc: after the warm-up gc.collect(), then the third generation's threshold at 10**9 until the run ends: ctx_store diagnosis §5. Only this mode
open_loop.phases: per-step CUDA events only; no per-phase events in these runs

slo.tpot: per request: (end to end - TTFT) / (tokens - 1); a request with one token has none

open_loop.capacity: per line and tier a rate passes when every seed run at it meets both limits; capacity is the interval from the last rate that passes before the first that fails to that one
report_only: slow steps: over 3 x the median of their kind and batch size; a tail stays in the tail
ITL and end to end p50 / p99

samehost.clock: wall clock on both sides, the GPU synchronized around it
samehost.order: at each (C, seed) nano's lines then vLLM's, back to back in one job; every run a new process
samehost.gap_rule: a gap remains on (line, C) when the 5 seeds' throughput ranges of nano and vLLM do not overlap; the other diagnostics run only there

vllm.runner_rule: dflash and dspark run only on the v2 model runner, whose k=0 line is k0_v2
vllm.dflash_rule: DeepSpec's DFlash checkpoint is a Qwen3DSparkModel without the Markov head, so dflash_k7 runs through vLLM's dspark method
vllm.seed_rule: --seed seeds the engine; every seed a new process, since repeats in one engine only advance one generator

diagnosis.where: D48, 5 dev seeds, only the (line, C) where samehost.gap_rule says a gap remains

experiments.name: torch
experiments.question: how much of the gap is the software version

experiments.name: segments
experiments.change: the same input state through both engines' round, timed in segments, with a host-side profile
experiments.question: is the gap on the GPU or on the host; vLLM's timing patch stays on this branch

experiments.name: temperature_draft
experiments.change: nano's drafts sampled with temperature only, as vLLM's
experiments.question: does tokens per round follow the top-k and top-p truncation of q

diagnosis.overflow: M3 §7: on real logits count the rows whose candidates overflow and the difference in q; no larger sample
diagnosis.merge_rule: nothing found here is merged: M5 stays off main; a single-factor gain over 2*N_t is recorded as a candidate for later
diagnosis.report: the gap and what each experiment moves, reported only

round_robin.rule: after the initial C requests of a closed loop are prefilled, a step admits at most one request and a prefill step is followed by a round; an open loop has no initial group
round_robin.boundary: the warm-up boundary of a run is the step of the last first delivery among its first C requests; the initial group is prefilled alike on both arms

metrics.throughput: Q_full over the same requests; the steady window would leave out the phase where requests wait for prefill
metrics.itl: every consecutive pair of a request's deliveries that starts at or after the boundary

verdict.itl_p99: every seed: rr / base at most this
verdict.q_full: the median over the seeds of rr / base at C = 8, 32, 64 each at least this; all seeds are listed. 2% is a trade the author accepts, not a statistical result
verdict.ttft: every seed: rr / base at most these
verdict.slo: on the same arrival plan, a tier the base line passes at a rate still passes with rr

open_loop.rates: the three highest rates at which the line passed either tier on the coarse grid; both arms in one job

round_robin.on_fail: any condition fails on either verdict line: the result is written down as a fail, nothing escalates to the mixed step
round_robin.order: all arms of one (C, seed) back to back in one job; the i-th dev seed starts with the (i mod 6)-th of k0, k0_rr, dspark_k7, dspark_k7_rr, dspark_var, dspark_var_rr

stop_if: identity finds a difference: no performance numbers from this tree; find the cause
an open-loop run preempts: the admission cap is wrong; find the cause
an invalid closed-loop run: its whole (C, seed) rerun once, per invalid_if
